faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the HAL Visiting Consultant (Ophthalmology) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the HAL Visiting Consultant (Ophthalmology) recruitment is 24th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Visiting Consultant (Ophthalmology) post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Visiting Consultant (Ophthalmology) post announced by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with MS/DNB (Ophthalmology) and 1 year of experience, or an MBBS degree with DOMS and a minimum of 2 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Visiting Consultant (Ophthalmology) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this position is 65 years as of 1st August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this HAL recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Visiting Consultant (Ophthalmology) post?
faq.answer: The position of Visiting Consultant (Ophthalmology) is on a contractual basis.

faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial application screening followed by document verification.
